steps.caption: The bell at the top shows new notifications. Click it.
'Brief ready' — the Zentrix meeting starts in about an hour, so its brief was prepared automatically.
The full list lives in More → Automation → Notifications.
It lists what is still missing for the meeting: decision-maker, verified contacts, budget, documents.
'Urgent' because the meeting is close. Informational notices wait for your working hours.
Open the notification to go to the meeting.
The meeting page: the brief has been generated (version 1) with a readiness score.
Scroll through the brief: company, requirement, open questions to ask.
Unknown facts stay unknown — the brief says what to find out, it never guesses.
How it works: the job is due 60 minutes before the start. Move the meeting and the job moves with it.
Cancel the meeting and the prep job and its reminders are cancelled too; the meeting record is kept.
Back in Notifications, press Done when you have read it.
